svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: Multi-Region active-active on AWS
svg.desc: Multi-Region active-active on AWS. 13 components in 5 groups. Connections: Users to Amazon Route 53 (resolve); Amazon Route 53 to AWS Global Accelerator (route); AWS Global Accelerator to Application Load Balancer (healthy Region); AWS Global Accelerator to Application Load Balancer (healthy Region); Application Load Balancer to Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service; Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service to Data tier (read and write); Application Load Balancer to Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service; Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service to Data tier (read and write); Data tier to Data tier.

text.tspan: Route 53 and Global Accelerator send users to the nearest healthy Region; each Region runs the full stack and its data replicates to the other
